qualification_scope: The listed DSpark K5 preparation signatures on a two-GB10 deployment; not all model JIT shapes.

source.image_scope: Unpublished local derivatives also carrying API-contract and IPC-wait changes; profile defaults unchanged.

conditions.cache_scope: Each serving /cache host-bind directory was newly created empty before startup; component probes used separate paths.
conditions.monitor: vLLM warn mode with verbose post-start JIT events on both ranks

gpu_component.method: Extract and AST-normalize the exact preparation kernel, wrapper and warmup bodies into a standalone module, preserving Triton constexpr annotations. No model is loaded and no NCCL collectives are executed.
gpu_component.positive_control_gate: Nonempty warmup JIT keys required before zero runtime events can pass.

serving.method: Tokenizer-derived raw IDs, unique first-block prefixes, exact prompt usage, positive bounded output usage, complete SSE and per-case health checks.

conclusion: The component control reproduced missing preparation signatures. Matching runtime dtypes and feasible scalar classes removed those gaps in the component fixtures and the bounded cold-serving request matrix.
limitations: Other attention, top-k, dense and routing JIT events remain; this does not resolve all startup-shape coverage in issue 188.
JIT warnings include first-use disk-cache resolutions and do not by themselves measure expensive cold compilation or its cost.
The 4096/4097-token inputs straddle the configured budget; the effective K5 scheduler budget is 3968, so both may be chunked. Actual iteration partitioning was not traced.
No TP4, all-shapes, 1M-token quality, long-soak or whole-model speedup qualification is established.
The initial calibration harness name-collision failure was excluded: health/tokenization succeeded, but no inference completion was sent. Its raw report is preserved separately.
Component AST replay checks preparation behavior and specialization reuse; it does not replace the separate serving result.

source_receipts.role: cold-cache creation and calibration controller source

receipt_retention: Raw receipts are retained privately; this record summarizes their scoped evidence without host addresses or complete JIT key strings.
